item.quote: Everyone from the moment you walked in the door was so sweet and welcoming. I am sure they see so many different artists every day but they were so interested in our outfits and learning about the musician from the merch to the stage! Everyone was so kind here and made the experience the best night my mom and I have had!
item.name: Anela

item.quote: First time I attended an event at the Rose Quarter. I had such an incredible experience. Parking was such a breeze. Staff was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. Overall such a great experience.
item.name: Rachel
